ECE 685 | Generation Mix II 27/28

Summary
Knowledge to carry forward
Annual-cost comparison: fixed cost sets a screening curve’s intercept.
Variable operating cost sets its slope.
Technology selection: crossover durations divide the operating-hour axis into
ranges in which different dispatchable technologies have the lowest annual cost.
Net-load allocation: mapping a crossover duration to the NLDC converts a cost
comparison into technology capacity blocks.
Load-matching capacity: round to whole units, then verify that every load block
is covered.
Final adequacy check: compare credited capacity with the PRM target. Add
enough capacity to close any remaining shortfall.
Match the load first, then verify the mix against the PRM target and close the capacity
gap.
